sources.title: Blackbird (isolated)
sources.author: richwise
sources.description: Close blackbird singing, recorded with Zoom H5 Studio XY microphones; faint distant traffic noted by the author.
sources.preview: Public HQ MP3 preview, not the original uploaded WAV.
master_conversion: HQ preview decoded to float PCM
48000 to 22050 Hz using normalized 256-tap rational-phase Kaiser-windowed sinc, radius 128, beta 8.6, cutoff 9500 Hz, reflect-padded; original speed and pitch preserved

sources.title: Perfect Spooky Owls
sources.author: DreamSavvyr
sources.description: Outdoor owl hoots recorded with a Tascam DR-05; the author edited spacing between calls.
sources.preview: Public HQ MP3 preview, not the original uploaded WAV.
master_conversion: HQ preview decoded to float PCM
44100 to 22050 Hz using normalized 256-tap rational-phase Kaiser-windowed sinc, radius 128, beta 8.6, cutoff 9500 Hz, reflect-padded; original speed and pitch preserved

environmental_entry_point: tools/generate_environment_audio.py delegates bird and owl preparation to the same recorded sound function
processing: Separate real excerpts, zero-phase light band limiting, edge fades, per-bank RMS target with peak cap; the existing environment writer adds its usual final DC correction and edge fades. No pitch shifting, time stretching, voice synthesis or added reverb.
